print_go_env_exports: print shell export statements for the hermetic Go toolchain environment variables
wrap_command_with_go_env: run a command like go version with the hermetic Go toolchain environment
prepare_go_environ: call bootstrap prepare_go_environ to get a dictionary of Go toolchain environment variables
find_executable_in_workspace: use bootstrap find_executable to locate an executable within the Go workspace path
get_go_workspace_dir: access the bootstrap WORKSPACE constant to get the Go workspace directory path
